summary.text: Mark Elworth Jr., who campaigned as "Marky Jr" and is a Libertarian Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House seat in Colorado's 5th District to Jessica Killin.
According to Ballotpedia he was born in Omaha, Nebraska, and worked as a salesman.
In his candidate survey he said he ran to challenge the two-party system, cut government spending and legalize marijuana nationwide.

paragraphs.text: Elworth was born in Omaha, Nebraska, graduated from the VanEd Educational Center in 2015 and has worked as a salesman, per Ballotpedia.
The Libertarian Party of Colorado lists him as its 2026 candidate for Congressional District 5.
In his Ballotpedia survey, he describes himself as challenging "the 2 party system and the status quo," and says he does not accept donations.
He received 1.9% of the vote to Jessica Killin's 50.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
